Senses.PreferredTarget: the last day of the twelfth month
Senses.Note: The literal year-end date becomes a deadline image: masters ask what remains usable when accounts, circumstances, and birth-and-death can no longer be postponed.

Occurrences.Kwic: 臘月三十日。將那一句敵他生死。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1998A.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dahui Pujue. Exact utterer: Dahui Zonggao. Dahui Zonggao asks what single saying a learned man will use against birth and death on the last day of the twelfth month.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若此中未穩臘月三十日是甚麼時候尚有工夫與你說閒話
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (L/L155/L155n1643.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Hongjue Min. Exact utterer: Hongjue Min. Hongjue Min says that if the matter is not secure, the year’s last day leaves no time for idle talk. Roster-linked exact speaker: Muchen Daomin.

Occurrences.Kwic: 雲峰悅禪師小參，舉百丈歲夜示眾曰：你者一隊後生，經律論固是不知也。入眾參禪，禪又不會。臘月三十日且作麼生折合去？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X64/X64n1260.xml). Outline Record of the Successive Patriarchs. Exact utterer: Baizhang Huaihai. Yunfeng raises Baizhang Huaihai’s year-end warning about how unprepared students will settle their account.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問：「今朝臘月三十日，作麼生是今日事？」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J38/J38nB425.xml). Complete Record of Chan Master Jifei. Exact utterer: Jifei Ruyi. Jifei Ruyi records an unnamed monk asking what the business of this literal last day of the year is.

Occurrences.Kwic: 老僧舊歲一年專與兄弟說虗頭話，逗到臘月三十日也無一句靈驗。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X70/X70n1382.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Wuzhun Shifan. Exact utterer: Wuzhun Shifan. Wuzhun Shifan says that after a year of empty talk, not one sentence proved effective by the last day.

Occurrences.Kwic: 到臘月三十日，諸緣交逼將來，難免攢眉蹙額
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J36/J36nB369.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Zhe’an Fan. Exact utterer: Zhe'an Jingfan. Zhe’an Jingfan warns that when the final day arrives and conditions press in, habitual conceptual understanding leaves one grimacing.

Occurrences.Kwic: 谷隱因僧問：如何是道？師曰：臘月三十日。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1297.xml). Dharma Grove of the Tradition’s Mirror. Exact utterer: Guyin Yuncong. Guyin Yuncong answers the student’s question about the Way with the last day of the twelfth month.

Senses.Explanation: The last day of the twelfth month is both the calendar’s year-end and a Chan deadline for what cannot be deferred. Dahui Zonggao asks what saying will meet birth and death then; Yunfeng raises Baizhang’s warning about how unprepared students will settle their account, and Zhe’an Jingfan describes conditions closing in. Jifei Ruyi’s questioner uses the literal date, while Hongjue Min says there will be no time for idle talk, Wuzhun Shifan tests a year of words at its deadline, and Guyin Yuncong makes the date a direct answer about the Way.
